summary: YY Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting completion of its at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program, under which it sold 93,880,252 Class A ordinary shares (adjusted for a 1-for-50 reverse stock split on March 23, 2026) for gross proceeds of $20 million. Net proceeds after a 3.75% sales agent commission and expenses were approximately $19.1 million. The ATM program, originally disclosed on February 27, 2026, was paused and relaunched, then concluded as of June 16, 2026. Net proceeds will be used to pay cash portions for 2025 acquisitions and for working capital and overseas expansion. The press release attached provides details.
